faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

q1.question: When will experiences launch?
q1.answer: Spring 2026. Waitlist members get first access.

q2.question: What's included in a retreat?
q2.answer: Varies by experience. Most include accommodation, curated activities, and meals. Specific inclusions are detailed in each proposal.

q3.question: Do you offer airport transfers?
q3.answer: Yes. For individuals and small groups (up to 3), we provide private airport pickup in a premium luxury SUV, ensuring your journey begins the moment you arrive.

q4.question: How are experiences selected?
q4.answer: We prioritize quality over quantity. Each host and location is personally vetted to ensure it aligns with our values: mindful, intentional, and uncommon.

faq.whatMakesDifferent: We don’t list everything. We curate what's worth your time. Access is limited by design, not scarcity marketing.

founder.heading: The Host
founder.title: Cauêh V.
founder.subtitle: Swiss Based. Alpine Rooted.
founder.bio1: I came to Switzerland looking for silence. I found it at 1,300 meters — in the stillness between peaks, the light at golden hour, and the slow precision of alpine life.
founder.bio2: Swissperiences is how I share that world. Every stay is personally hosted, every detail personally chosen. No algorithms, no call centers — just a door held open.
founder.quote: Your journey isn't managed. It's hosted.
